description: This Java source file defines the class List12, which is an Android activity demonstrating the use of a ListView with transcript mode. It allows user input via an EditText, adds the input to the list, and handles key events.

classes.name: List12
classes.description: An activity demonstrating a list view in transcript mode with user input capability.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, setting up the list adapter, input field, and event listeners.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on the EditText and sends the input text to the list.

methods.name: sendText
methods.description: Retrieves text from input field, adds it to the adapter, and clears the input.

methods.name: onKey
methods.description: Handles key events; when Enter or D-Pad center is pressed, sends the input text.
